scope: Selected-M scientific source model/FP32 head/role and execution-authority boundaries. Isolated tiny fixtures only. GPU bridge/final M driver and actual production cache qualification remain explicitly unimplemented/unadmitted; their absence alone is not a finding.

findings.title: 输出 namespace 验证之前已可在根目录外创建提取锁
findings.location: source_best_cache.py:290 versus role_path:131-133 and first role check:296
findings.explanation: extract opens trainer.exclusive_file on the raw root/features/source_best_M/admission/run path before calling the canonical non-symlink namespace guard. If root/features is a symlink outside root, the original lock helper follows it and creates directories/extract.lock outside the permitted M namespace. A later role_path check raises, after the write already occurred.
findings.reproduction: Use the existing tiny D project fixture; symlink root/features to an existing temporary outside directory, stub _permit for synthetic-only execution, and forbid model construction. extract eventually raises canonical path escape but outside/source_best_M/<admissionSHA>/<run>/extract.lock exists. No real data or production paths were used.
findings.impact: The advertised secondary-namespace rejection is not side-effect-free and can touch a foreign/primary destination before rejecting the run.
findings.requested_change: Validate the complete extraction directory and lock path with the same canonical/no-symlink root guard before any mkdir/open/flock. Add an extract-level regression asserting no outside directory/file is created and no encoder is allocated.

findings.title: 生产许可及四份门控证明仅检查一次，执行期间漂移不会拒绝
findings.explanation: _permit validates permit/proof SHAs using throwaway bound dictionaries. Their paths/pins and joint-capacity evidence are not retained by BoundContext or an execution authority snapshot. Later full context checks only recheck source/data/primary context; they do not rebind permission or its cache/storage/capacity proofs. The extracted-role result also provides no indication that the permission inputs changed during execution.
findings.reproduction: Tiny D fixture with four synthetic external authority proof files and a matching SHA-pinned permit accepted by the real _permit. At _build_model, replace the permit and all4 proof bytes with revoked payloads, then return the tiny fixture model. Real CPU extract still returns M_SOURCE_BEST_CANDIDATE_ROLES_COMPLETE_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_ADMISSION with all6 roles. Direct context.check(full=True) likewise accepts changed permit, which is absent from c.pins. This tests lifetime integrity, not the legitimacy of an actual production issuer.
findings.impact: A CPU encoder run can continue through changed/revoked authority/capacity evidence even though source inputs remain immutable. Unimplemented GPU dispatch still rejects correctly, but does not protect this implemented CPU path.
findings.requested_change: Keep a sealed execution-local authority snapshot containing the permit and all referenced gate hashes; recheck it before allocation/each role and before successful completion, including an appropriate fresh capacity check. Record the authority snapshot in execution evidence while allowing content-identical cache reuse under a newly qualified permit. Add permit/proof mutation-during-extraction regressions. Do not issue any actual M production permit from the current source-only stage.
